_note: For `npm run endpoints`: the mapped requests a default scan does not find in the site's code, by map, each as '<METHOD> <path>' the way the scan prints it. The scan reports a request that is absent and not listed here as NEW, which is the sign that the site moved something. The six legacy ones belong to the uploads, hospital-stays and purchased-drugs pages, which the scan opens only with --legacy-pages (it then finds them); the recommendations page is named in the code without /online/. Edit by hand when a map or the site changes.
